Re: Account reference: ACC-553014

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the above-referenced account. We understand that you are disputing the debt collection activities of Vanguard Debt Services, and we will investigate this matter further.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. However, our records indicate that we have already provided validation to you in the past, and you have not disputed the debt. Nevertheless, we will provide you with a copy of the validation letter, which includes the original creditor's name, Lakeshore Utilities, and the current balance of $192.63.

We will also investigate the charge-off date of 2023-10-12 and the last payment date, which is not on file. We will review our collection activities to ensure compliance with the FDCPA and Oregon state law.

We will not contact your brother or any other third party regarding this account, as this is a violation of the FDCPA. We will only communicate with you directly regarding this matter.

You have the right to dispute this debt further, and we encourage you to contact us in writing if you have any additional information or concerns.

Sincerely,

Vanguard Debt Services
